answer: We formulate dynamic opportunity-cost bonds demanding staking collateral, ensuring any agent that chooses to wander from protocol rules encounters strict subgame-perfect slashing penalties. Such cryptoeconomic security primitives, integrated with zero-knowledge verifiable delay and a juniper network, mathematically drive the expected payoff of identity multiplication below zero. Consequently, this rigid capital barrier constructs a robust sonnet of deterrence, compelling rational actors into a strict Nash equilibrium where Sybil attacks yield strictly negative expected utility.
